Additional dated rows seen: 2026-02-27 Jebel Ali, UAE, HS 48239090, BOL 1092178; 2026-02-26 Jebel Ali, UAE, HS 48239090, BOL 1045349; 2026-02-25 Jebel Ali, UAE, HS 48239090, BOL 1019664; 2026-02-24 Jebel Ali, UAE, HS 48239090, BOL 9968003. Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 13435 Records detected", "Trading Partners 86", "Ports 91", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; rows actually visible on the free view = 5 shipment rows (plus 5 supplier rows and 5 buyer rows in adjacent tables). Top ports listed: Jebel Ali 1305, NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1 1011, NHAVA SHEVA SEA 943, Rotterdam 233, SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4 89.
domestic_evidence: Screener.in consolidated P&L (https://www.screener.in/company/TCPLPACK/consolidated/): "Sales + 498 593 613 698 816 890 904 1,086 1,475 1,541 1,770 1,810 1,979" (Rs crore, FY2015–FY2026, TTM 1,979) and quarterly "Sep 2026 ... Sales 561". Company description: "Incorporated in 1987, TCPL Packaging Ltd manufactures paperboard-based packaging materials and flexible packaging products ... India's largest folding carton manufacturer and convertor of paperboard." Listed BSE: 523301, NSE: TCPLPACK. Source counter: 13 annual columns and 13 quarterly columns displayed, all read; no GeM/CPPP tender rows were retrieved (search tool was down), so domestic evidence rests on reported turnover, not on individual contract records.
note: Both dimensions are factually supported. Export: real, dated customs shipments from Nhava Sheva to Rotterdam (NL) and Jebel Ali (UAE) in Feb 2026, with bill-of-lading numbers and HS codes — not a website claim. Domestic: large audited/reported turnover (Rs 1,979 cr TTM consolidated, Rs 561 cr in Sep-2026 quarter) confirms actual supply into the Indian market; individual GST band and GeM/CPPP contract records were not retrieved because the web_search backend returned connection errors, so those specifics are null rather than invented. HS observation: declared codes 480439/481390/481910/550410 are paper-board/folding-carton codes; the observed shipment lines carry 48192090 and 48239090 (printed cartons and other paper-board articles), which are adjacent subheadings of the same product family — the declared set is broadly consistent with the actual trade, with the specific subheadings to be corrected to 48192090/48239090 as observed. Industry label 'Строительство и DIY' (construction/DIY) does not match the actual business (folding cartons and flexible packaging for FMCG/cigarettes); this is a classification remark only, not a rejection ground. PAN AAACT1406E was not independently verified in this pass (registry scope excluded). No rejection grounds: the entity is active, listed and shipping.
